items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: I think I was reading where Lionel Hampton said that the days that he’d be playing with Benny, and it was when Charlie Christian was with the band.

ctx.x: When he had that amazing success, you know if what I’ve read is correct, at the Palomar Ballroom. And it’s hard to separate your memory from something that is so consequential in your career. Like that was the moment, and we paid our dues to get there, so it carries a weight.

I think I was reading where Lionel Hampton said that the days that he’d be playing with Benny, and it was when Charlie Christian was with the band. And those were my favorite recordings of his. I think it was just — he was on fire. And they said that Benny’d be playing and he was so happy you could see tears coming out of his eyes. You know? So again, here’s this guy who’s got this tremendous gift, but he wasn’t able to communicate verbally very well what he was feeling, but it all came out in his music. So that…

working just the way he wanted it to do. And the guys were playing the way that he would prefer it. And it was probably harder for him later on to find guys that could recapture that the way that he wanted it. You know? I don’t know.
